links.outcome: Effect of sponsor (insurer vs AI developer) of copay waiver on patient choice of AI screening
links.effect: Waiving copay raised AI selection (81% vs 43%, p<0.001); the source of the incentive (insurer vs AI developer) did not affect choice.
links.quote: Waiving the copay significantly increased AI selection (81% vs. 43%, p < 0.001); the source of the incentive did not affect choice.
